// since: comparison operators in the if header. Both sides carry one
// static type: a literal adopts the other side's type, and a named
// scalar type compares by its kind, which is how the time.Duration
// from time.Since orders against time.Hour.
t := time.Now();
req := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://example.com/api/users");

status := 200;
class := "";
if status == 200 {
	class = "ok";
} else {
	class = "error";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "ok", class);

grade := "";
if status >= 500 {
	grade = "5xx";
} else if status >= 400 {
	grade = "4xx";
} else {
	grade = "routine";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "routine", grade);

method := "";
if req.Method == "GET" {
	method = "read";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "read", method);

kind := "load";
if req.Method != "GET" {
	kind = "store";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "load", kind);

age := "stale";
if time.Since(t) < time.Hour {
	age = "fresh";
}
assert.Equal(tb, "fresh", age);
